summary:
Verified booking email notification to agendamento@castassessoria.com.br. Created targeted test file (test_booking_email.py) with 3 tests covering: (1) rejected booking does not send email, (2) accepted booking triggers background email + 202 from Resend proxy + success log line, (3) HTML in name/notes is escaped and newline converted to
. All 3 PASS. Backend logs confirm: 'INFO:email_service:Booking notification sent to agendamento@castassessoria.com.br' and 'POST https://integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted'. Frontend regression: booking submit through UI shows booking-confirmation with correct booking details. Only 1 TEST_ booking kept (2 created total, both cleaned up via admin DELETE).

verifications.background_task: server.py create_booking adds notify_new_booking via BackgroundTasks (non-blocking); booking returned with id even if email fails
verifications.email_failure_safety: notify_new_booking wraps send_email in try/except -> errors logged, booking not affected (code review confirmed)
verifications.html_escaping: notify_new_booking uses html.escape() on name, email, phone, service_label, date_br, time, notes;
verifications.weekend_past_duplicate: 400/400/409 validation unchanged (test_create_booking_weekend_rejected, past rejection code path + 409 duplicate verified in prior iterations)
verifications.frontend_confirmation: booking-confirmation renders with 'Agendamento recebido, TEST_FrontendUser2.' + 'Passaporte Brasileiro · 20/10/2026 às 10:00'

critical_code_review_comments: notify_new_booking relies on os.environ['BOOKING_NOTIFY_EMAIL'] without fallback — ok because .env is loaded at startup; if missing the exception is caught in try/except so booking still succeeds (good).
date_br = '/'.join(reversed(booking['date'].split('-'))) assumes ISO date format; input is validated upstream via date_cls.fromisoformat so safe.
_assert_safe_email runs on every send; if subject contains user-provided dynamic text in the future, note that only service_label is used today (static), so no risk currently.
Consider adding retry/backoff for transient Resend errors (currently single-shot) — low priority since failure is logged and booking is not blocked.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_ bookings (one via API test, one via UI). Both deleted via admin DELETE /api/admin/bookings/{id}. Each triggered 1 real email to agendamento@castassessoria.com.br.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email notification feature works end-to-end. To re-test without spamming the client inbox, only run test_booking_email.py (sends 1 email per run) or run the HTML-escape unit test which stubs send_email. Full backend_test.py also creates a booking that sends an email — prefer the targeted file.
